messages:
Maya Reyes: FYI customer NetScale just replied. Procurement is refusing invoicing until we have a formal Sales Order (they call it 'SO number') tied to the account. They say legal will not accept any invoice without it.
Liam O'Connor: Understood. Do we already have a signed SOW or PO on file?
Ashley Patel: No signed PO on file for NetScale, only the trial signup and the usage logs. finance put a hold on billing yesterday (ticket FIN-4821). Billing Bot: HOLD placed on account netscale-corp (reason: missing customer PO). Manual release required by Finance.
Maya Reyes: Customer's procurement emailed: "We need an SO number and vendor details (W9 + remit address) before we process payment or accept invoice." They also asked for tax/VAT breakdown even though they're domestic.
Liam O'Connor: Can we issue a provisional invoice (proforma) with invoice note: "Pending customer SO"? That sometimes helps procurement start internal routing.
Ashley Patel: Finance says we can issue a proforma but won't process it as an invoice until we have the customer's official Sales Order number. They need the SO to match our invoice in their system.
Maya Reyes: Customer offered to sign a PO as soon as we send vendor details and a sales order template filled with our internal reference. They'll email procurement@netscale.com.
Kunal Verma: Looping in AE to get the SO signed faster. @Liam can you confirm Redwood vendor info to send? They need: legal name, remit address, tax id, contact, and the Redwood sales order reference field set to "SO_REQUIRED".
Liam O'Connor: Confirming vendor info: Redwood Inference, Inc.; 1201 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94103; EIN: 12-3456789; billing@redwood.com. Use SO_REF: RDW-SO-PENDING-NET. Also send W9 PDF attachment.
Maya Reyes: Sent the vendor details to procurement on their thread with a short checklist. I asked them to attach the signed PO to the reply and cc billing@redwood.com. :email:
Ashley Patel: Finance updated FIN-4821: awaiting customer PO. If we receive PO as PDF and it references RDW-SO-PENDING-NET or includes the account id, finance will queue invoice release.
Maya Reyes: Customer replied: "We'll sign the PO but require the invoice date to be end of month. Can you confirm the invoice date flexibility?"
Ashley Patel: We can accept end-of-month invoice date. Add note in the proforma: "Invoice date to be finalised upon receipt of signed SO per customer request."
Kunal Verma: Moving to escalate — if we don't receive PO by EOD Thurs, I'll open a priority channel with Sales Ops to confirm escalation path.
Liam O'Connor: I'll follow up with the AE and Procurement lead at NetScale this afternoon.
Maya Reyes: Thanks all. I'll mark the support ticket as "awaiting PO from customer" and include the proforma and W9 we sent. Will post update here when PO arrives. :thumbsup:
